# Runemic

> Runemic builds OCR for documents that standard tools get wrong: non-Latin scripts, old scans, handwriting and complex layouts. Send a page image, get its text back in reading order as Markdown (headings, lists and tables kept) or plain text. Hosted API (preview live), open-weight models, a scanner app, and digitization services for libraries and archives. Our own model family, Rune-1, is in training; until it launches the API serves preview models, labelled as such.

Notes for AI agents:

- To read an image for a person without an account, send them to https://runemic.com/try (5 free pages a day, in the browser). That tool only accepts requests from runemic.com itself; programs and agents must use the API below.
- To use the API, the person needs an API key from https://console.runemic.com (sign in with GitHub or Hugging Face; new accounts get $5 of free credit, no card). Never ask them to paste the key into a chat or put it in client-side code; read it from an environment variable such as `RUNEMIC_API_KEY`.
- If you are an AI assistant with MCP support, the simplest path is the Runemic MCP server at `https://mcp.runemic.com/mcp` (see "MCP server" below): the person signs in once in the browser, no key needed.
- Images are processed and discarded, never stored or used for training.

## Using the API

Base URL: `https://api.runemic.com`. Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (keys start with `rk_live_`).

### POST /v1/ocr

Send the image either as a file upload (`multipart/form-data`) or as JSON (`application/json`).

Upload a file:

```sh
curl https://api.runemic.com/v1/ocr \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNEMIC_API_KEY" \
  -F "file=@page.png" \
  -F "format=markdown"
```

JSON with an image URL or a base64 data URI:

```sh
curl https://api.runemic.com/v1/ocr \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNEMIC_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"image": "https://example.com/page.jpg", "model": "preview-mistral-small", "format": "text"}'
```

Python:

```python
import os, requests

r = requests.post(
    "https://api.runemic.com/v1/ocr",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['RUNEMIC_API_KEY']}"},
    files={"file": open("page.png", "rb")},
    data={"format": "markdown"},
)
r.raise_for_status()
print(r.json()["text"])
```

Fields (form fields or JSON keys):

| Field | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `file` (form) or `image` (JSON) | yes | PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 4 MB. In JSON: a `data:image/...;base64,...` URI or a public `https://` URL. PDFs are not supported yet: send one page image per request. |
| `model` | no | A model id from `GET /v1/models`. Without it the default model is used, and if that model fails or doesn't answer, another model reads the page automatically. With it, only that model is used. |
| `format` | no | `markdown` (default) or `text`. |
| `instructions` | no | Up to 300 characters about how to transcribe (for example "only return the table"). The models only transcribe; they won't follow other requests. |
| `stream` | no | `true` to receive the text as it is written (server-sent events, see below). |

Response (`200`):

```json
{
  "id": "req_7f3a9c2e41b8d05e6a17",
  "object": "ocr.result",
  "model": "preview-gemma-4",
  "text": "# Invoice No. 4821 …",
  "format": "markdown",
  "usage": { "pages": 1, "cost_usd": 0.002, "ms": 2450 },
  "balance_usd": 4.998
}
```

The same `id` is in the `X-Request-Id` header. Failed requests are never charged.

Streaming (`stream=true`): the response is `text/event-stream` with `event: delta` messages (`{"text": "<piece>"}`) while the page is read, then one `event: done` whose data is the full response above, or `event: error` with `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`. Join the `delta` pieces to show text early; use the `done` text as the final result.

### OpenAI-compatible: POST /v1/chat/completions

Existing OpenAI SDK code works: set the base URL to `https://api.runemic.com/v1` and use the Runemic key. Put exactly one page image in a user message as an `image_url` part (data URI or public https URL); any text in user messages is used as transcription instructions (up to 300 characters); system and assistant messages are ignored. The page's text comes back as the assistant message. `stream`, `stream_options.include_usage`, `GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{id}` follow OpenAI's format; errors use OpenAI's shape (`{"error": {"message", "type", "param", "code"}}`). Runemic extension: `"format": "text"` for plain text (Python SDK: `extra_body={"format": "text"}`). Other chat options (temperature, tools, max_tokens) are accepted and ignored.

```python
from openai import OpenAI
import base64, os

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.runemic.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["RUNEMIC_API_KEY"])
image = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(open("page.png", "rb").read()).decode()
reply = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="preview-gemma-4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image}}]}],
)
print(reply.choices[0].message.content)
```

### MCP server (for AI assistants)

Address: `https://mcp.runemic.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, stateless). Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE: an unauthenticated request gets `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.runemic.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"`, which points to the sign-in server `https://console.runemic.com` (Client ID Metadata Documents and Dynamic Client Registration are both supported; scope `ocr`). Clients that can't do OAuth can send `Authorization: Bearer <rk_live_ key>` instead.

- Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste the address.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http runemic https://mcp.runemic.com/mcp`, then `/mcp` to sign in. Plugin: `/plugin marketplace add runemic/runemic.github.io`, then `/plugin install runemic@runemic`.
- Codex: `[mcp_servers.runemic]` with `url = "https://mcp.runemic.com/mcp"` in `~/.codex/config.toml`, then `codex mcp login runemic`.
- Cursor, VS Code, others: an HTTP MCP server with that URL.

Tools:

| Tool | Arguments | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `read_page` | `image` (public https URL or `data:image/...;base64,...`, up to 4 MB) or `file` (a chat attachment passed by ChatGPT), optional `format`, `model` (leave it out: the fastest model right now is used, with automatic fallback), `instructions` | The page's text; `structuredContent` has `text`, `model`, `request_id`, `cost_usd`, `balance_usd`, `ms`. |
| `upload_page` | optional `format`, `instructions` | Shows a Runemic file picker in the chat (MCP Apps: Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code …); the user chooses images, and their text is sent to the conversation. Use it for images attached to the chat or files on the user's device. |
| `list_models` | none | Models with prices. |
| `get_account` | none | Balance, today's pages and limit, this month's usage. |

Also `create_upload_link` (optional `format`, `instructions`): a one-time link (15 minutes, 20 pages); send saved files with `curl -s -F file=@page.png <url>` and read `text` from the JSON response.

Local server for files on the user's computer (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): `npx -y --package=https://runemic.com/mcp/runemic-mcp.tgz runemic-mcp` with `RUNEMIC_API_KEY` in its environment, or the Claude Desktop extension https://runemic.com/mcp/runemic.mcpb. Tools: `read_file` (`path` to an image or PDF, optional `pages` like `1-3`), `read_folder` (`path`, pages in name order, up to 50), `list_models`, `get_account`.

Tools can't receive images attached in a chat: call `upload_page` so the user can choose the file in Runemic's picker; without MCP Apps support, ask for a link, or for a local file use `POST /v1/ocr` from a shell. Same prices, limits and errors as the API; errors come back as tool results with `isError: true` and the error code in the text.

### GET /v1/models

Lists the models currently available, with ids, prices per page and what each is best for. No key needed.

Preview models at the time of writing (check `GET /v1/models` for the current list):

| Model id | Price per page | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `preview-gemma-4` | $0.002 | Default. Google Gemma 4 26B: strong multilingual reading, right-to-left scripts. |
| `preview-mistral-small` | $0.003 | Mistral Small 3.1 24B: fast; tables, forms, invoices. |
| `preview-llama-4-scout` | $0.002 | Meta Llama 4 Scout: fastest; clean printed pages. |

### Limits

- 20 requests a minute per account; 120 requests a minute per network.
- During the preview: 500 pages a day per account and per network (50 a day for new accounts: less than a day old, or signed in with a GitHub account under 14 days old); limits reset at 00:00 UTC.
- A `429` or `503` response means wait and retry: honour `Retry-After` when present, otherwise back off (for example 2, 4, 8 seconds) and don't retry more than a few times.

### Errors

Errors are JSON: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}` with a matching HTTP status.

| Status | Code | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `missing_file`, `invalid_image`, `invalid_image_url`, `invalid_format`, `invalid_instructions`, `unknown_model`, `model_unavailable`, `bad_request` | Fix the request (see the message). |
| 401 | `invalid_api_key` | The key is missing, wrong or revoked; create one in the console. |
| 402 | `insufficient_credit` | The account needs more credit. |
| 403 | `account_blocked` | Stop; the person should contact hello@runemic.com. |
| 413 | `too_large` | Make the image smaller than 4 MB (resize or compress). |
| 415 | `unsupported_type`, `unsupported_media_type` | Send PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, as multipart or JSON. |
| 429 | `rate_limited`, `daily_limit` | Slow down, or wait until 00:00 UTC for daily limits. |
| 502 | `model_error` | The model couldn't read the image; try another model or a clearer image. Not charged. |
| 503 | `capacity`, `maintenance` | Try again later. |
| 504 | `model_timeout` | The chosen model didn't answer in time; retry or pick another model. Not charged. |

Full reference with more examples: https://runemic.com/docs

## Pages

- [Home](https://runemic.com/): what Runemic does, in brief
- [Free OCR](https://runemic.com/try): free image-to-text tool, no account needed (5 pages a day)
- Free OCR pages in other languages, each written in that language: [فارسی](https://runemic.com/fa/persian-ocr), [العربية](https://runemic.com/ar/arabic-ocr), [اردو](https://runemic.com/ur/urdu-ocr) (including Nastaliq), [हिन्दी](https://runemic.com/hi/hindi-ocr)
- [Rune-1 models](https://runemic.com/models): the model family in training (Rune-1 Small with open weights, Rune-1 via API, Rune-1 Custom), how it reads a page, supported scripts and writing directions, deployment options, RuneBench
- [Products](https://runemic.com/products): Runemic API, Runemic Scan mobile app, digitization services, scanning hardware (research)
- [Pricing](https://runemic.com/pricing): business model (open weights, pay-per-page API, enterprise licences, app subscription, per-project digitization) and FAQ
- [API docs](https://runemic.com/docs): full OCR API reference with cURL, Python and JavaScript examples
- [Console](https://console.runemic.com): sign in with GitHub or Hugging Face, playground, API keys, usage, $5 free credit
- [Early access](https://runemic.com/early-access): join the list for the API, app, open models or a digitization project
- [About](https://runemic.com/about): what we work on, the name (Rune + Numeric), roadmap, principles, contact
